prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use refined warm lifestyle editorial photography: considered light and composition with relaxed believable interaction, never a glossy advertising pose. A 74-year-old woman with a silver bob and a cream cardigan sits comfortably on a plain wooden chair, meeting the camera with calm confidence and the slightest smile. Use a warm off-white wall, softly lit curtains, gentle broad window light, and a considered chest-up portrait preserving her natural age lines. Output a square 1:1 composition for a website gallery. Make the key expressions and interaction readable at thumbnail size, with breathing room around the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct invented appearance: a neat chin-length silver bob with gently curled ends, deep natural smile lines, dark warm eyes, a slightly angular face and a small sturdy build. Her subtle knowing smile is restrained.
Composition priority: exact 1:1 aspect ratio, one complete standalone photograph with comfortable safe margins.
review: Reviewed full square image: older woman with a silver bob and cream knitted cardigan sits on a wooden chair, with a calm slight smile and visible natural age lines. Face and eyes are coherent, no visible hands or text; soft curtains and flowers form a quiet background. Square 1254x1254.
